L_0plus_provenance.origin: Both MATLAB implementation references assign 9.4 mH.
L_0plus_provenance.interpretation: The paper reports 0- only. The 0+ entry is preserved from the code; the isolated-neutral current is zero and the common-mode term cancels from all constrained line voltages.

reported_nameplate_values_for_context_on.note: These reported ratings are not the optimization limits. The manuscript sentence does not define every RMS/peak or terminal convention for these ratings.

physical_limits.phase_current_definition: max over electrical angle and phases b-f of abs(i_k)
physical_limits.line_voltage_definition: max over electrical angle and all 10 healthy-terminal pairs of abs(v_p-v_q)
physical_limits.source_note: tau_mx is stored in the LUT; current and voltage limit values are verified from the paper and matching MATLAB references.

lut.reference_interpolation: linear interpolation of phase-dependent Fourier coefficients at feasible lookup inputs
lut.boundary_interpolation_implementation_st: deferred_to_later_steps; no zero-filled infeasible corner may be silently used

back_emf.processing_definition: Interpolate six phase-shifted waveforms on the selected even angle grid; first half = 0.5*(raw first half - raw second half), second half = negative first half.
back_emf.actual_back_emf_definition: e_k = omega_m * e_prime_k, with omega_m in rad/s
back_emf.figure_4_processing_distinction: The Fig. 4 plotter confirms mechanical-rad/s normalization, but displays raw back-EMF using pchip without half-wave symmetrization. The selected OPF model uses linear interpolation and half-wave symmetrization matching the LUT metadata.

unit_and_equation_conventions.torque_definition: T=sum_k e_prime_k*i_k + Tcog, with Tcog=0 for this case.
unit_and_equation_conventions.quasi_steady_cycle_assumption: One electrical cycle is reconstructed at a fixed torque-speed operating point. Ramp coefficient time derivatives and closed-loop current tracking are not modeled by this configuration.
unit_and_equation_conventions.low_frequency_convention: Holding coefficients at the first retained LUT column does not replace actual mechanical speed in back-EMF or voltage evaluation.
